text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer.
I'm counting on you again this year.
choice_data_list: Same here, look forward to working with you!
Same here, looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... You're full of energy.
Having you around is truly reassuring.
choice_data_list: What are your aspirations for this year?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course...
"To win the Arima Kinen"!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to grow and prepare for that.
So, what's my first race?

"Though I felt it might be a bit premature,
I had already spent the New Year holidays
thinking up strategies."

The Arima Kinen is a race where only the elite Umamusume
chosen and eagerly awaited by the fans are allowed to run.

In other words, just as before, we must continue growing your fanbase
while steadily building up a solid track record in GⅠ races.
And then—
choice_data_list: Why don't we start with the distance you're best at?
Why don't we start with your best distance?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My ideal distance, huh... That said,
what I usually ran back in my hometown was sprint distance, soâ

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—The mile.
Yeah, the mile sounds great.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I have confidence when it comes to the mile.
I'm sure I'll be able to show everyone a great run.
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone just how strong Oguri is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

First, compete at her optimal distance,
and then expand Oguri Cap's potential.
That's the direction we agreed upon.

Our next target race is...
the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Trainer.
What should we do first this New Year?"
choice_data_list: Let's eat plenty and have a healthy year!
Let's add to the things you're good at!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦
Going to the gym so early in the New Year?
choice_data_list: It's to make this a year where I can dominate with power!
It's so I can have a year where I can really shine with power!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Is that for good luck as well?
Understood, I shall go train.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I wanna eat some food when we're done.
Food is an important source of power, after all.

Afterward, Oguri Cap and I headed to
the gym and had a solid workout.
...Though her meal portion grew accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is it really...
okay for me to eat this?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...!
To tell you the truth, I was a little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's so much delicious food around New Year's,
so I was worried about what to do if I wasn't allowed to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, nothing to worry about anymore.
Alright, Trainer, let's feast on New Year's!”

I'd rather not talk too much about
what happened after that...
Still, it did help Oguri Cap stay healthy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My strong suit... huh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even someone clumsy like me...
Can I learn to do more?
choice_data_list: Let's tackle it steadily and take our time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
The year has only just begun.

Even with her clumsy start, Oguri Cap showed
her willingness to take on the challenge.
I'm certain her skills will continue to improve.
